findings.gap: Readers may return empty or omit an independent assertion; candidate verification only sees proposed items and early-returns on empty input. Execution receipts explicitly remain semantic_coverage and fulfillment unassessed.
findings.smallest_safe_change: Keep truthful unassessed coverage now. Design explicit independent original-source omission/no-change review at an existing responsible review boundary, with owned source/target IDs and precise reasons; do not turn self-reported source coverage into proof.
faults: Empty output dropping new date correction
Only unrelated accepted detail while requested correction omitted
findings.call_impact: A prompt clarification at an already running review adds no call. Reviewing previously bypassed empty stages would add conditional calls and requires explicit accounting.
findings.dependency: Effect fulfillment and independent semantic coverage require a surfaced owning-contract change; no silent cross-file schema change.

findings.gap: Unready opening whitespace-only strings are treated as substantive contradictory metadata on an unconstrained first-turn schema.
findings.smallest_safe_change: Strip party_name, subject and summary before ready/unready validation, consistent with opening_from_parts. Preserve rejection when normalized unready fields contain substantive text.
legitimate_neighbours: Supported ready heading containing whitespace around fields
faults: ready=false carrying actual party or subject
ready=true with empty normalized subject or summary
findings.call_impact: No new call; avoids one repair for meaning-free formatting.
findings.limit: Existing-matter schema enum restrictions run before local parser; this narrow change covers the first-turn unconstrained form only.

findings.gap: Repeated identical selected owned assignment or target IDs trigger a blocking correction although the decisions use set semantics. Exact prior references already deduplicate in resolve_sources.
findings.smallest_safe_change: Validate string ownership first, then deduplicate only exact repeated selector IDs before deriving assignment or checking target uniqueness. Preserve independent candidate rows and all substantive content.
legitimate_neighbours: Same explicit correction target ID repeated
findings.call_impact: No new call; fewer formatting repairs.
findings.dependency: Implement normalization at material.py owning helpers; do not weaken source/target ownership or normalize distinct facts.

findings.owner: source treatment semantic decision and recovery
findings.gap: A structurally valid but semantically wrong source-role decision can block a legitimate repair; downstream reviewers cannot revise the source-owner classification.
findings.smallest_safe_change: Keep current ownership gate. Design a bounded candidate-free reconsideration of the affected original span at the source owner rather than allowing the writer/reviewer to override it. A true examination-only source must remain unusable as substantive account.
legitimate_neighbours: Earlier genuine account mislabeled examination, followed by review-only authority

findings.dependency: Surface source-owner feedback/recovery contract and retain successful unrelated classifications.

findings.gap: Generation sees union reference/target/peer vocabularies, while per-candidate ownership is enforced afterward; semantically valid rejection also supplies unused positive-check bookkeeping.
findings.smallest_safe_change: Present keyed code-owned candidate IDs with each candidate's own valid choices and verdict-applicable shapes, preserving accepted-effect proof requirements. Do not loosen ownership validators.

Accepted peer selecting only its own target/source

findings.owner: Bounded verifier recovery and adapter boundary
findings.gap: Verifier retains valid semantic peers during repair, but exhaustion raises and loses in-memory valid results. Whole-schema provider rejection can hide peers before their per-candidate parser. Generic extractor repair replaces the full envelope and can omit valid original proposals.
findings.smallest_safe_change: Do not globally turn errors into empty success. Preserve safe units only with explicit pending/unread coverage and enforced restoration dependencies at the owning unit contract; otherwise retain truthful withholding. Verify actual adapter failure behavior with deterministic stubs before claiming per-unit recovery.

One missing verdict beside accepted unrelated proposal

findings.finding: Both reviewers return immediately for no candidates; for nonempty outputs they review only proposed units. The source classifier covers purposes, not which materially significant account/repair obligations were extracted. Whole-proposal and successor checks do not independently inspect general omissions. Empty and partially omitted extraction therefore leave semantic coverage unassessed.
findings.minimal_fix: At one existing independent review owner, add explicit original-account/request coverage judgment and unresolved/omitted source-linked units; use the same populated-candidate call, and a conditional coverage-only call when relevant material work returned no candidates. Code reconciles owned declared coverage and carries missing work; it must not infer semantic completeness from source roles, count or an empty envelope.

Wrong: extractor emits valid new circumstance but omits independent date correction in the same message.
Legitimate: greeting/read-only recap has no requested change and no significant new material.
Legitimate: actual review establishes current record already satisfies the requested correction.
findings.call_impact: No additional routine call for populated review when coverage shares its original evidence; relevant empty-result coverage adds one conditional independent read plus only declared bounded repair. Do not force extraction or a coverage call for every interaction.

Explicit partial/no-change/unfinished coverage handoff and release completion gate
findings.evidence_limit: Static current-code contract; no actual model semantic quality evaluated.

findings.type: source-owner false rejection and recovery gap
findings.finding: Schema-valid source treatment is a downstream veto: examination, work_instruction, nm_interpretation or uncertain may not support a positive account. The only source-owner retry is structural SchemaViolation; there is no route to reconsider a semantically mistaken purpose. This prevents candidate-driven promotion but can suppress genuinely reported uncertain account or earlier original support for authorised repair.
findings.minimal_fix: Keep ownership immutable downstream. First evaluate source-owner judgments against independently labelled neighbouring cases. When an actual consequential disagreement is demonstrated, route a precise original-framing mismatch back to the source owner for one bounded reconsideration using original transcript, without a desired candidate formulation or silent upgrade. Preserve all unaffected classifications.
counterexamples: Legitimate: tentative/unproved advocate report remains reported account; uncertain truth is not uncertain source purpose.
Legitimate: real opposing legal position remains that speaker position, not NM analysis.
Legitimate: mixed request includes reported facts; pure review authority cannot supply facts.
Legitimate: review request repairs NM date using earlier advocate account, without fresh assertion.
Wrong: quoted analysis or instruction is promoted because a proposed correction needs support.
findings.call_impact: Zero added normal-path calls; any proven semantic mismatch recovery is conditional and counted under an explicit bound.
depends: Downstream pending coverage instead of invented factual repair
findings.evidence_limit: Structural unrepairability shown by code; no observed real-model misclassification claimed.

findings.finding: Provider receives one verdict-array item schema with a union of all candidate source/target/peer vocabularies; candidate-specific eligibility appears only in input text and later local validation. Every reject also requires complete positive account_check/target_checks fields, even when unused. Thus correct semantic judgments can require repair due to offered wrong bookkeeping choices or irrelevant metadata.
findings.minimal_fix: Expose server-keyed per-candidate verdict objects with that candidate exact allowed sources, targets and peers; use portable provider-supported shapes to separate accept-required attestations from an explained reject. Normalize only empty/inapplicable fields whose removal cannot change meaning; substantive contradictory support or identity content is not harmless. Keep accept ownership and source/target enforcement unchanged.
counterexamples: Legitimate: C1 accepted with its own evidence while C2 rejected for no dispute; C2 need not invent positive source/target attestations.
Legitimate: rejected proposal has empty unused arrays and clear consequential reason.
Wrong: C1 chooses a C2-only source/target offered by the shared schema.
Wrong: acceptance contains nonempty contradictory content or unowned source; no normalization can hide it.
findings.call_impact: Same normal call count; reduces conditional repairs if actual provider evaluations support it.
depends: Portable schema subset (current local validator has no oneOf/anyOf support)
Verifier schema and parser ownership agreement
One production file/prompt per sequential slice; shared helper/API changes must identify inseparable dependencies
findings.evidence_limit: Static shape mismatch and retry conditions; actual false rejection rate remains unmeasured.

findings.type: per-unit recovery reaches neither terminal nor adapter boundary
findings.finding: A successfully returned schema-valid envelope retains independently valid peer decisions during one repair. If any remaining unit stays malformed, the reviewer raises and no valid peer result is returned to caller. Production adapters validate the entire schema before returning data, so one structural defect can also hide otherwise valid siblings before the per-candidate retention parser. Direct scripted verifier fixtures do not prove recovery across either boundary.
findings.minimal_fix: Define an explicit partial-review result carrying checked peers and pending IDs/reasons, and enforce existing retirement successor dependencies before allowing any independently safe effect. Whole-turn integrity faults still withhold. Prove envelope/adapter behavior before claiming structural per-unit retention; preserve typed contract authority rather than bypassing provider validation to consume malformed data.
counterexamples: Legitimate: independent material A verified, independent B remains malformed after its one repair; A can survive if owned coverage explicitly records B unfinished.
Wrong: retiring a merged target when a necessary B successor failed would erase underlying account.
Wrong: treating unread B as semantic reject/no relevant material.
Wrong: history/identity/ownership integrity fault is handled as a harmless independent candidate defect.
findings.call_impact: No extra retries or normal calls; existing one-correction bound retained.
depends: Partial-result handoff to turn coverage/effect persistence
Production adapter boundary fixtures and actual model contract behavior
findings.evidence_limit: Valid decisions are lost to verifier caller on terminal raise; exact durable turn-recovery behavior is outside these four audited files.

findings.type: generic replacement may erase valid proposals
findings.finding: checked_read validates the whole response and asks for a complete replacement. Its repair guidance permits unsupported proposal omission but has no independent-unit retention or semantic coverage reconciliation. Source catalogue coverage is protected by required keys, but extraction replacement arrays can lose previously sound proposals or become empty while still schema-valid.
findings.minimal_fix: Keep generic source/schema correction bounded. For readers that contain independently usable proposal units, put validation/retention at their owning parser and carry only unresolved units into repair with complete original evidence; explicitly reconcile omissions. Do not turn failure into empty extraction, or keep prior units whose ownership/support was never validated.
counterexamples: Legitimate: one malformed prior-source link repaired while a separately valid new reported event remains.
Wrong: replacement fixes the link by deleting every significant valid peer, then empty envelope is treated as complete.
Legitimate: source treatment correction returns complete required catalogue without altering original words.
Wrong: context overflow drops original transcript instead of only redundant rejected output.
findings.call_impact: Same one conditional correction maximum; no routine extra stage.
findings.evidence_limit: Mechanism permits proposal omission; no observed omission attributed to a real model in this audit.

findings.finding: Prompts correctly distinguish current authorised work from source factual support, but verifier payloads contain no typed request/purpose or required effect/success condition. Each verifier must rediscover current authorised activity from conversation. operation_supported remains a semantic proposal judgment and cannot mechanically establish per-request fulfillment.
findings.minimal_fix: Carry the owning interpreter/work-unit purpose and request identity as visibly separated work context to the relevant operation reviewer, preserving original evidence independently. Code checks which requested activity/effect was covered; reviewer decides semantic support. Do not require a fresh assertion for repair or let typed purpose supply the restored fact.
counterexamples: Legitimate: earlier advocate evidence plus current authorised repair restores a derived record.
Legitimate: read-only recap uses saved state without inventing a record write.
Wrong: new legal theory is treated as authority to change original account.
Wrong: unrelated accepted material is used to mark a distinct correction request complete.
findings.call_impact: No new model stage; add typed context to existing relevant read/review call.
depends: Request-to-effect/result linkage and checked current-state alternative
Cross-file input plumbing must be planned as sequential atomic slices
findings.evidence_limit: No claim that missing field necessarily caused an observed model error; this is a contract/receipt limit.

recommended_order: F1: define semantic coverage/no-change obligation at existing independent review boundary; never claim receipts alone assess it.
F3: reduce offered bookkeeping contradictions with candidate-specific schemas, preserving accept invariants.
F5/F4: prove bounded per-unit recovery through reader, adapter, verifier and turn handoffs before claiming complete retention.
F2: measure real source-purpose errors and implement only evidenced consequential owner reconsideration.
F6: carry owned request/purpose context and bind supported results; do not upgrade semantic judgment into mechanical proof.
source_verification_audit.validation_limits: Audit is static plus reading existing scripted regressions. Existing fixtures often fill account/target checks automatically and classify sources as reported account; passing such fixtures is routing/validation evidence, not pinned-model semantic accuracy, omission coverage or false-positive rate.
